# Objective

Implement the post-G9 `CeDG Dihedral Procedures` workspace on
`feature/g9u2-dihedral-procedures-workspace`.

**PROPOSED FUTURE PROMPT — UNEXECUTED, NOT AUTHORIZED, AND BLOCKED ON THE
AUTHOR-APPROVED GLOBAL G9 GATE.**

# Mandatory entry gate

Require explicit global G9 `PASS — AUTHOR APPROVED`, approved U2 workspace/
procedure contracts, Accepted workspace ADR, green U0/X1/U1/A/B/C and composed
verification, clean branch and exact prompt hash. No narrower pilot is implied.

# Hard dependencies

The author-approved global G9 closeout and the implemented G9U1 manifest/action
substrate are hard dependencies. The global gate already includes the A/B/C and
U0/X1/U1 tracks; no individual phase PASS substitutes for it.

# Recommended execution predecessor

Execute only after the global closeout record and evidence are frozen. There is
no pre-closeout U2 pilot in this prompt.

# Global/release gate

U2 is post-G9 product work. Its own release decision remains separate from the
global G9 design/implementation closeout that authorizes entry.

# Authority and evidence hierarchy

Read implemented G9 spatial semantics/certificates and Construction workspace,
then approved U2 design, canonical CeDG procedures and current kernel commands.

# Scope

Implement the reduced procedure workspace and approved explicit tools for change
of projection plane, rotation, folding, true magnitude, auxiliary projecting
plane, section, derived projection, reconstruction, reprojection and consistency
inspection using typed spatial selections/bindings/frames, ProjectionSystem,
ProjectionDiagramMap and hinge/change-of-plane relations.

# Explicitly forbidden scope

No opaque one-click CAD operations, manual label association, hidden geometric
steps, new spatial truth in GUI, arbitrary defaults that resolve ambiguity,
unapproved kernel families, or Classic mutation.

# Editable boundaries

Workspace manifest/resources, GeoCeDG procedure controllers, approved shared
composed algorithms only where specification requires, tests/models/docs/
evidence/verifier and registered upstream edits.

# Productive versus test-private permissions

Only approved explicit procedures are productive. Workflow mocks and unsupported
spatial-family pilots remain test-private.

# Architectural placement

Procedure geometry and dependencies are normal shared-kernel algorithms;
workspace/controller manages selection/options and never becomes authority.

# Required design/specification

Resolve spatial object -> defining bindings -> hinge/destination frame ->
declared intrinsic `q=pi(x)` data -> typed diagram map `p=delta(q)` -> explicit
auxiliary construction -> result/provenance -> validity certificate.
Generated-object ownership and protocol visibility are mandatory; the
workspace may select an approved map but never derive one from viewport state.

# Geometric invariants and degeneracies

Preserve constructive steps, frame orientation, projection coherence and typed
ambiguity. Coincident hinges, projecting/degenerate planes, insufficient
bindings and invalid certificates stop or present explicit choices.

# Compatibility and serialization

Use G9 IDs/bindings and U1 workspace schema. All generated construction steps
save/reopen/undo normally. Workspace switching cannot reinterpret objects.

# Required tests and commands

Test every procedure, selection/default/ambiguity dialog, generated ownership/
protocol, ProjectionSystem/map/hinge validation, intrinsic/diagram round trips,
common-gauge and zoom/camera independence, lifecycle/XML, degeneracies, help/
localization/icons and Classic isolation; focused G9U2 and composed verification
without `-SkipBuild`.

# Required artifacts

Source/tests/canonical procedure models/resources, UX evidence, validation
matrix, counters, verifier, traceability and report.

# Stop conditions

Stop without approved global G9, if a procedure hides constructive dependencies,
if selection falls back to labels/proximity, or if GUI state becomes geometry.
